source_code_evidence.description: GET /api/v1/user/list — list_user，Query page/page_size/username/email/dept_id；结果排除 password，并按 dept_id 逐条填充 dept
GET /api/v1/user/get — get_user，Query user_id 必填；排除 password
POST /api/v1/user/create — create_user，body UserCreate；email 已存在返回 Fail code=400；随后 update_roles(role_ids)
POST /api/v1/user/update — update_user，body UserUpdate（含 id）；路由层未见 email 唯一性预检；随后 update_roles(role_ids)
POST /api/v1/user/reset_password — reset_password，Body embed user_id；成功消息固定为「密码已重置为123456」
User 模型：username CharField(max_length=20, unique)；email CharField(max_length=255, unique)；password；is_active；is_superuser；roles M2M Role；dept_id IntField(null)
UserCreate schema：email(EmailStr)/username/password 必填；is_active/is_superuser/role_ids/dept_id 可选；create_dict 排除 role_ids
UserUpdate schema：id/email/username 必填；is_active/is_superuser/role_ids/dept_id 可选；无 password 字段
PermissionControl.has_permission：is_superuser=True 直接 return，旁路角色-API 绑定校验
PermissionControl：无角色绑定返回 403；method+path 不在 role.apis 集合返回 403
AuthControl.is_authed：token=="dev" 时取 User.filter().first() 作为当前用户（开发后门）
web/src/views/system/user/index.vue — 用户管理页（唯一前端入口文件）

in_scope: User 字段约束：username/email 唯一与长度、role_ids/dept_id 关联、is_active/is_superuser
DependPermission 鉴权与 unauthorized 负向
前端 web/src/views/system/user/index.vue 管理员用户管理流程（列表/搜索/新建编辑/删除/角色与部门绑定）
UserCreate/UserUpdate 输入的 Fuzz 覆盖
list_user 分页列表性能冒烟（含按行填充 dept）
out_of_scope: 跨模块深度集成（除 dept_id / role_ids 绑定外）
非 admin 角色的 E2E 细粒度权限矩阵（API 层覆盖 unauthorized 即可）
token=="dev" 开发后门的产品化改造（仅作结构事实记录）

layer_recommendation.rationale: 模块暴露 6 个 REST 端点（SC-ROUTE-001..006），含 CRUD、列表过滤、reset_password，并具备唯一性/RBAC 结构约束（SC-MODEL-* / SC-RBAC-*）
存在 system/user 管理页（SC-FE-001）；需求明确要求覆盖列表/搜索/新建编辑/删除/角色与部门绑定
create/update 接受用户输入 schema UserCreate/UserUpdate（SC-MODEL-002/003），适合对 email/username/role_ids/dept_id 做边界与畸形输入覆盖
list_user 为分页核心列表路径，且对每条记录按 dept_id 二次查询填充 dept（SC-ROUTE-001），具备列表性能冒烟价值；需求/审批亦勾选 Performance

test_strategy.approach: API 核心覆盖用户 CRUD/唯一性/角色部门绑定/鉴权与 reset_password，E2E 冒烟管理员用户管理页，对 UserCreate/UserUpdate 增加 Fuzz，并对 list_user 做 Performance 冒烟

proposed.title: User create returns 500 on user.username UNIQUE constraint
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/user/create lacks an application-level username uniqueness precheck. Duplicate username (API TC_USER_API_010 and fuzz TC_USER_FUZZ_001, e.g. colliding with existing admin) propagates SQLite/Tortoise IntegrityError as HTTP 500 envelope instead of a 4xx conflict/validation response. Robustness and assert_ideal contracts require status_code < 500 / client error.

candidates.recommended_action: Add username uniqueness precheck on create and return 4xx conflict; confirm fuzz create no longer surfaces IntegrityError as 500.

proposed.title: User update with invalid role_ids clears prior valid role bindings
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/user/update with INVALID_ROLE_ID returned a non-5xx client/business failure path (TC_USER_API_011 passed status < 500 and client-error checks), but list m2m afterward showed role bindings empty (expected prior valid role retained). Failed/invalid role update appears to clear M2M bindings instead of leaving prior associations unchanged.

candidates.recommended_action: Validate role_ids before mutating M2M; on rejection leave existing user-role bindings intact; re-run TC_USER_API_011.

proposed.title: User create accepts non-existent dept_id as success
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/user/create with INVALID_DEPT_ID returned HTTP 200 Created Successfully (TC_USER_API_012). Missing FK existence validation allows users to be created against a non-existent department instead of rejecting with 4xx/business failure.

candidates.recommended_action: Validate dept_id exists before create; return 4xx when missing; ensure no orphan user persists for invalid dept.

proposed.title: User update returns 500 on user.email UNIQUE constraint
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/user/update assigning another user's email returns IntegrityError UNIQUE constraint failed: user.email as HTTP 500 (TC_USER_API_017). Update path lacks email uniqueness precheck present on create, so DB constraint failures surface as server errors instead of 4xx conflict.

candidates.recommended_action: Add email uniqueness precheck on update mirroring create; return 4xx and leave target user email unchanged.

proposed.title: User update accepts incorrect dept_id type as success
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: Schemathesis AcceptedNegativeData on TC_USER_FUZZ_002: POST /api/v1/user/update returned HTTP 200 Updated Successfully when dept_id was boolean false. Schema/type validation for dept_id is too permissive; schema-violating typed input should be rejected as 4xx rather than accepted.

candidates.recommended_action: Tighten Pydantic/OpenAPI typing for dept_id on update; reject non-integer values with 4xx; re-run TC_USER_FUZZ_002.

proposed.title: User list performance scenario fails with 100% error rate
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: Locust scenario user-list-query against GET /api/v1/user/list recorded measured_error_rate=1.0 (threshold 0.01) while measured_p95_ms=12.0 remained under the 2000ms latency threshold. Near-instant total failure suggests request-level errors (auth/env/product response failures) rather than latency degradation under the configured 10-user / 30s load.

candidates.recommended_action: Inspect Locust failure classes/auth seed for user list; fix auth or product error source until error_rate is under threshold, then re-run performance.

proposed.title: User/role domain factories and cleanup missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: API-PLAN-FINDING-KNOWLEDGE-001: .aa/data-knowledge.yaml registers adapters.api.user and adapters.api.role but omits capabilities.domain_factories.user / role and cleanup.user_delete / role_delete even though on-disk tests/testdata/domain modules define make_*/cleanup_* used by those adapters. Codegen that trusts only L1 may omit or reinvent factories.

candidates.recommended_action: Promote domain_factories.user/role and cleanup.user_delete/role_delete into .aa/data-knowledge.yaml via knowledge remediation.

proposed.title: On-disk user API tests 014/016 drift from case.yaml semantics
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: API-PLAN-FINDING-CODEGEN-001: existing tests/api/test_user_api.py still implements TC_USER_API_014 as forbid_reset_superuser_password and TC_USER_API_016 as reject_no_role_superuser_access, contradicting case.yaml (014=non-admin reset rejection; 016=no valid role-API bind). If codegen only appends, case_id backfill maps wrong behaviors.

candidates.recommended_action: During api codegen, rewrite/retarget mapped 014 and 016 functions to api-codegen-plan Test Function Mapping; do not preserve drifted implementations.

proposed.title: User assert-ideal negative contracts diverge from current product error shapes
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: API-PLAN-FINDING-EXEC-001 warned that assert_ideal cases TC_USER_API_010/011/012/017 may fail against current SUT (email-only create precheck; Tortoise FK handling; missing update email uniqueness). Batch execution failures for those cases confirm the contract/intent risk beside the product defects.

candidates.recommended_action: Keep assert_ideal expectations until product aligns; track product gaps via issue candidates rather than silently rewriting cases to observational pass.

proposed.title: E2E user/role adapters and domain_factories.user missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: PLAN-FINDING-001: E2E plan seeds/cleans via tests.e2e.adapters.user and role (and dept.make_dept) with on-disk symbols, but .aa/data-knowledge.yaml lacks capabilities.adapters.e2e.user / role, adapters.e2e.dept.make_dept, and domain_factories.user. Codegen that trusts only L1 may omit the seed bridges.

candidates.recommended_action: Promote adapters.e2e.user/role make/cleanup, adapters.e2e.dept.make_dept, and domain_factories.user into .aa/data-knowledge.yaml.

proposed.title: E2E user sidebar menu labels remain SUT-dependent confirmations
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: PLAN-FINDING-004: TC_USER_E2E_001 prefers sidebar navigation (系统管理 → 用户管理). Page chrome is evidence-backed from index.vue, but sidebar menu seed labels are not confirmed solely from that view file, so locator failures may be misclassified as product defects.

candidates.recommended_action: Confirm sidebar labels against running SUT; keep sider-scoped menuitem strategy and navigate_user_mgmt fallback.
